summary.title: Assignment 2  Zero Trust E-Commerce Platform
summary.description: This threat model represents a Zero-Trust modernization of an e-commerce platform with three microservices: UserAuth, ProductCatalog, and OrderProcessing. The design applies centralized authentication, token-based authorization, and least-privilege service-to-service communication. A Gatekeeper (API Gateway) validates all tokens for both external clients and internal microservices. The model shows the login flow, token issuance, and secure service interactions.
